segments.oily: One reviewer with oily/acne-prone skin reports the formula as comedogenic and breakout-causing due to Glyceryl Stearate SE and Coconut Alkanes, while other reviewers report no greasy feel and no new breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the serum as hydrating, non-irritating and well suited to dry or textured skin.
segments.sensitive: Multiple reviewers with sensitive skin report no burning, redness or irritation, with several explicitly recommending a patch test first as a precaution.
segments.mature: One reviewer with mature skin reports it as a gentle, lightweight, non-irritating treatment for hyperpigmentation.
segments.combination: No reviews specifically describe combination skin.

concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, discoloration and hyperpigmentation, often within one to three weeks; no reviewer reports worsening of spots.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report fewer breakouts, faster healing of active acne, or fading of post-acne marks; one reviewer with oily/acne-prone skin reports the opposite, stating the formula is comedogenic and causes breakouts.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness alongside fading discoloration; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.aging: One reviewer specifically describes it as well suited to mature skin and its associated hyperpigmentation.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the serum as hydrating, leaving skin soft and not tight, with no reports of dryness caused by use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports their skin barrier feeling better after use; no other barrier-specific comments are given.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers state the serum does not feel greasy or oily after absorption; one reviewer with oily/acne-prone skin instead reports comedogenic ingredients.

aspects.libelle: No white cast, layers well under makeup

extraits.texte: Was so excited for this product until I saw Glyceryl Stearate SE and Coconut Alkanes in the ingredients :( These are not acne friendly and cause breakouts in oily/acne prone people! So disappointing

extraits.titre: i would buy this product over and over again
extraits.texte: "This milky serum is a total game-changer for post-acne marks! It absorbs super fast, has zero scent, and doesn't irritate my skin at all. After just two weeks of use before my moisturizer, my stubborn dark spots started to fade and my overall redness calmed down. Plus, at around $17, the price point for a 10% azelaic acid formula is unbeatable!"
This product is extremely helpful, I have very dry and sensitive skin and this product does so well with my skin type. Hydrating and also makes my skin very smooth.

I've been using the Bubble Dream Fade Serum, and I actually really like it! I have super sensitive skin, so I get scared trying new products because my face gets irritated so easily, but this one has been really gentle on my skin. It didn't burn or make my face red, and it feels really lightweight. I've noticed my acne marks starting to fade, and my skin just looks more even overall. It also layers really well with the rest of my skincare and doesn't feel sticky. If you have sensitive skin like me, I'd still say do a patch test first because everyone's skin is different, but personally it's worked really well for me. Definitely one of my favorite serums so far. 🤍

Dream Fade is my new go to serum! It's the perfect treatment for my mature skin and the hyperpigmentation that comes along with it. It's super lightweight and absorbs easily into my skin. I use it every morning and night in my routine. The bottle is a nice size and you get a good amount of product. It's also a really nice light exfoliator that does not irritate my skin. It's perfect for sensitive skin and especially mature skin. This is my new go to serum.
